description: A practical toolkit for data analysts to assess data quality, plan cleaning, engineer features, write Oracle SQL, and prepare Tableau reports.

defaultPrompt: Audit this dataset for quality issues and report counts with clear denominators.
Plan reproducible cleaning steps for this dataset and explain how to validate the results.
Write an Oracle SQL query for this analysis using the schema and business rules I provide.
interface.longDescription: Provides practical guidance for data-quality assessment, reproducible cleaning, feature engineering, Oracle SQL, and Tableau reporting. It explains assumptions and validation steps and does not connect to databases or modify datasets.

name: data-analyst-toolkit
